verdict.rationale: Solid's README states almost verbatim that Resources let server-loaded data be used like any other state, with Suspense and concurrent rendering providing a responsive loading UI (solid-gh-3). Suspense and concurrent rendering are also listed as built-in features (solid-gh-11). One community user advises avoiding Suspense, but that is a general caution rather than a concrete documented failure, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party API documentation of createResource/Suspense behavior (loading/error states, refetching), independent hands-on corroboration that the resource+Suspense flow works well in practice.
